# Tsh056 — Merging adjacent same-surface faces hangs on a face whose wire forms a figure-eight

## Description

A face's outer wire visits one vertex twice (figure-of-eight topology), so the wire is non-simple. Same-surface face merging walks edges and never terminates because the visited-edge map records edges, not edge-with-direction, and the figure-of-eight makes the iterator revisit the same edge from the opposite side indefinitely.

## Reproducer recipe

A single face whose `FACE_OUTER_BOUND` has 6 edges forming a figure-eight at one vertex (vertex `B` has 4 incident edges in the wire). Run face unification.

## Expected kernel behavior

edge-walking iterators on non-simple wires must terminate (use vertex+direction or edge+direction in the visited map); reject pathological wires before iterating.

**Structured outcomes** (extracted from prose; for downstream auto-grading):
- allowed: `reject`
